title: Get Started with futebolplotR
text: easiest way get futebolplotR install :
code: if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak") pak::pak("brunomioto/futebolplotR")

title: Get Started with futebolplotR
text: Let’s explore standard scenarios utilizing futebolplotR. Initially, load essencial packages. load data Campeonato Brasileiro explore database. select 2025 season Campeonato Brasileiro.
code: library(futebolplotR) library(ggplot2) library(dplyr) library(brasileirao) season_2025 <- brasileirao::matches |>   dplyr::filter(season == 2025) |>   brasileirao::add_variables() |>   # brasileirao doesn't have an abbreviation for Mirassol yet   mutate(home_abbr = if_else(home == "Mirassol", "MIR", home_abbr))  season_2025_home <- season_2025 |>     group_by(home) |>     summarise(home_abbr = first(home_abbr),               total_home_points = sum(home_points),               goal_concede_home = sum(as.numeric(away_score)),               goal_scored_home = sum(as.numeric(home_score)),               .groups = "drop") |>     rename(fc = home)  season_2025_away <- season_2025 |>     group_by(away) |>     summarise(total_away_points = sum(away_points),               goal_concede_away = sum(as.numeric(home_score)),               goal_scored_away = sum(as.numeric(away_score)),               .groups = "drop") |>     rename(fc = away)   df_teams <- season_2025_home |>     left_join(season_2025_away, by = "fc") |>     mutate(goals_concede = goal_concede_home + goal_concede_away,            goals_scored = goal_scored_home + goal_scored_away,            goals_difference = goals_scored - goals_concede)

title: Get Started with futebolplotR
text: Firstly, visualize points earned home away team. done demonstrate can use team badges.
code: ggplot(df_teams, aes(x = total_home_points, y = total_away_points)) +   geom_abline(color = "grey30")+   futebolplotR::geom_futebol_badges(aes(team_abbr = home_abbr),                                     width = 0.064, alpha = 0.8) +   labs(     x = "Points home",     y = "Points away",     caption = "Data: williamorim/brasileirao",     title = "Campeonato Brasileiro 2025"   ) +   theme_minimal() +   theme(     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),     plot.title.position = "plot"   ) +   coord_fixed(     xlim = c(5, 50),     ylim = c(5, 50),     clip = "off"   )

what: Team Colors and Badges as Axis Labels
title: Get Started with futebolplotR
text: Now, demonstrate can incorporate team’s specific colors shapes (case, bars graph) can use team badges axis labels.
code: ggplot(df_teams, aes(x = reorder(home_abbr, -goals_scored),                               y = goals_scored)) +   geom_col(aes(color = home_abbr, fill = home_abbr),            width = 0.6) +   futebolplotR::scale_color_futebol(type = "secondary") +   futebolplotR::scale_fill_futebol(type = "primary") +   labs(     title = "Campeonato Brasileiro 2025",     y = "Goals Scored",     caption = "Data: williamorim/brasileirao"   ) +   theme_minimal() +   theme(     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),     plot.title.position = "plot",     axis.title.x = element_blank(),     # this line triggers the replacement of team abbreviations with badges     # use axis.text.x.bottom (not axis.text.x) with complete themes like theme_minimal()     axis.text.x.bottom = futebolplotR::element_futebol_badge(size = 0.8)   ) ggplot(df_teams, aes(x = reorder(home_abbr, -goals_difference),                               y = goals_difference)) +   geom_col(aes(color = home_abbr, fill = home_abbr),            width = 0.6) +   futebolplotR::scale_color_futebol(type = "secondary") +   futebolplotR::scale_fill_futebol(type = "primary") +   labs(     title = "Campeonato Brasileiro 2025",     y = "Goals difference",     caption = "Data: williamorim/brasileirao"   ) +   theme_minimal() +   theme(     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),     plot.title.position = "plot",     axis.title.x = element_blank(),     # this line triggers the replacement of team abbreviations with badges     # use axis.text.x.bottom (not axis.text.x) with complete themes like theme_minimal()     axis.text.x.bottom = futebolplotR::element_futebol_badge(size = 0.8)   )

title: Get Started with futebolplotR
text: Badges can also added single position plot annotate(). useful highlight team, add badge plot background.
code: fluminense <- df_teams |>   filter(home_abbr == "FLU")  ggplot(df_teams, aes(x = goals_scored, y = goals_concede)) +   annotate(     "futebol_badges",     x = mean(range(df_teams$goals_scored)),     y = mean(range(df_teams$goals_concede)),     team_abbr = "FLU",     width = 0.35, alpha = 0.15   ) +   geom_point(color = "grey40") +   annotate(     "futebol_badges",     x = fluminense$goals_scored, y = fluminense$goals_concede,     team_abbr = "FLU",     width = 0.08   ) +   labs(     title = "Campeonato Brasileiro 2025",     subtitle = paste0(       "Fluminense: ", fluminense$goals_scored, " goals scored and ",       fluminense$goals_concede, " conceded"     ),     x = "Goals scored",     y = "Goals conceded",     caption = "Data: williamorim/brasileirao"   ) +   theme_minimal() +   theme(     plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),     plot.title.position = "plot"   )

title: Brazilian Soccer Badges Plots in ggplot2
text: key function package geom_futebol_badges() add Brazilian soccer team badges ggplot. can see current available teams (currently 46) plot.  information using package, check Getting Started article
code: library(futebolplotR) library(ggplot2)  team <- futebolplotR::valid_team_names()  n_cols <- 5 n_rows <- ceiling(length(team) / n_cols)  df <- data.frame(   a = rep(1:n_cols, n_rows)[seq_along(team)],   b = rep(n_rows:1, each = n_cols)[seq_along(team)],   teams = team )  ggplot(df, aes(x = a, y = b)) +   geom_futebol_badges(aes(team_abbr = teams),                       width = 0.1) +   geom_label(aes(label = teams,                  color = teams,                  fill = teams),              linewidth = 0.5,              nudge_y = -0.35)+   scale_color_futebol(type = "secondary")+   scale_fill_futebol(type = "primary")+   theme_void()+   theme(     plot.margin = margin(15,15,15,15,"pt")   )+   coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

code: # \donttest{ library(futebolplotR) library(ggplot2)  team_abbr <- futebolplotR::valid_team_names()  df <- data.frame(   a = rep(1:5, 2),   b = sort(rep(1:2, 5), decreasing = TRUE),   teams = team_abbr[1:10] )  # keep alpha == 1 for all teams including an "A" matches <- grepl("A", team_abbr[1:10]) df$alpha <- ifelse(matches, 1, 0.2) # also set a custom fill colour for the non "A" teams df$colour <- ifelse(matches, NA, "gray")  # scatterplot of all badges ggplot(df, aes(x = a, y = b)) +   geom_futebol_badges(aes(team_abbr = teams), width = 0.075) +   geom_label(aes(label = teams), nudge_y = -0.35, alpha = 0.5) +   theme_void()   # apply alpha via an aesthetic from inside the dataset `df` # please note that you have to add scale_alpha_identity() to use the alpha # values in your dataset! ggplot(df, aes(x = a, y = b)) +   geom_futebol_badges(aes(team_abbr = teams, alpha = alpha), width = 0.075) +   geom_label(aes(label = teams), nudge_y = -0.35, alpha = 0.5) +   scale_alpha_identity() +   theme_void()   # apply alpha and colour via an aesthetic from inside the dataset `df` # please note that you have to add scale_alpha_identity() as well as # scale_color_identity() to use the alpha and colour values in your dataset! ggplot(df, aes(x = a, y = b)) +   geom_futebol_badges(aes(team_abbr = teams, alpha = alpha, colour = colour), width = 0.075) +   geom_label(aes(label = teams), nudge_y = -0.35, alpha = 0.5) +   scale_alpha_identity() +   scale_color_identity() +   theme_void()   # apply alpha as constant for all badges ggplot(df, aes(x = a, y = b)) +   geom_futebol_badges(aes(team_abbr = teams), width = 0.075, alpha = 0.6) +   geom_label(aes(label = teams), nudge_y = -0.35, alpha = 0.5) +   theme_void()   # }

text: geom_futebol_badges() element_futebol_badge() much faster. badge now rasterised per session reused, alpha longer goes magick::image_fx(). scatter plot 20 badges alpha went ~25 s ~1.7 s (first draw) ~0.1 s (redraws). element_futebol_badge() works . supports colour (including "b/w"), alpha, angle size, works axis text facet strips. (#4) geom_futebol_badges() element_futebol_badge() warn unknown team abbreviations draw generic badge instead leaving empty space. Team data now lives data-raw/teams.csv, package doesn’t depend brasileirao anymore (’s used Getting Started article). Team names now stored UTF-8. Badge files moved inst/badges/. Removed unused dependencies glue lifecycle; brasileirao withr moved Suggests. Added unit visual tests.
